IS 7016 (Part 7) : 2009 ISO 1420: 2001

Indian Standard

METHODS OF TEST FOR COATED AND TREATED FABRICS
PART 7 RUBBER-OR PLASTICS-COATED FABRICS - DETERMINATION OF RESISTANCE TO PENETRATION BY WATER

( Second Revision)
WARNING - Persons using this International Standard should be familiar with normal laboratory practice. This standard does not purport to address all of the safety problems, if any. associated with its use. It is the responsibility of the user to establish appropriate safety and health practices and to ensure compliance with any national regulatory conditions.

1

Scope

This International Standard specihes a pass/ta il method for the determination of the resistance of rubber - or plastics-coated tabncs to water penetration (hydrostatic resistance) when subjected to a spcc .t.c hyd rostatic pressure over a fixed period of time Two test specimen shapes are given one is circular , the othe r square

2

Normative references

The following normative documents c ontam provistons which , through reference In trus text , constitute provis rons at this International Standard . For dated references , subsequent amendments to. or revisions of, any of these publications do not apply However. parties to agreements based on trus International Standard are encouraged to mvestiqate the POSSibility of applying the most recent editions of the normative documents Indicated below . For undated references. the latest edition of the normative document referred to applies . Members of ISO and lEG maintain registers of currently valid International Standards . ISO 2231 :1989 , Rubber- or plastics-coated isbncs Standard atmospheres for conaiuorunq and testmg Oetermmsuon of roll cnsrectenstcs Part' : MethodS for

ISO 2286-1:1998. Rubber- or plastics-coated tsbrtcs detenninstion of length, Width and net mass

3

Principle

A test specimen of coated labric is subjected to an increasing pressure of water on one face . under standard conditions. until a predetermined pressure specitied in the coated-fabric specification IS obta ined . The reqUired pressure is maintained for a specified time or until penetration occurs. whIChever is the sooner.

4
4.1

Apparatus General

The apparatus shall consist of an open-mouthed vessel fined With a ctamp to fasten the test specimen over the mouth. The lower part of the vessel shall have a nozzle allowing it to be connected to a water inlet pipe to fill It With water at room temperature. A retain ing mesh is fitted over the test spec imen. This mesh shall comprise wires of 1 mm to 1,2 mm diameter forming squares of side not greater than 30 mm .

1

IS 7016 (Part 7) : 2009 ISO 1420: 2001 4.2 Means of measuring water pressure

Either a manometer, connected to the test head, allowing water pressures up to 19,6 kPa (200 cmH 20) to be read to an accuracy of t 1 % , or a pressure gauge. graduated in centimetres head of water or in kilopascals and with a maximum reading of at least 100 kPa (946 cmH 20 ), shall be used to measure the wate r pressure appl ied to the test spec imen .

4.3

Test area

The open mout h of the vesse l (see 4 .1 ) over which the test spec imen is clamped shall be eithe r a square of side 100 mm or a circle of orarnete r 113 mm , gIVing an area of 100 cm 2 in each case. If necessary, soft rubber seal ing gaskets can be employed between the coated-fabric test spec imen and the surlaces of the clamps in order 10 reduce Ihe nsk of damage to the test specimen by Ihe clamps , and to facilitate the testing of seams . In this respect, rubber having a hardness of approximately 40 IRHD (Intemational Rubber Hardness Degrees) and approximately 0 ,5 cm thick or 1 em In diameter has been found useful. Alternat ively, a closed-cell, crosslinked-polyethylene foam hav ing a density of 45 kg/m 3 to 55 kg/m 3 and approximately 1 cm thick can also be used.

5
5 .1

Test specimens
Taking teat specimens

Take test spec imens from an area with no functional or visible defects and located in the usable width of the coated fabric as defined in ISO 2286-1.

5.2

Number

Unless otherwise specified in the material specification, test five specimens in each series of tests .

5.3
5.3.1

Shape and cfimenaiona
Square apec:1mena

Each specimen shall be square with sides measuring approx imately 200 mm .

5.3.2

Circular apec:i~

Each soecirnen shall have a diameter of 130 mm 10 200 mm .

5.4

Conditioning

Immediafely prior to testing . cond ition the specimens for at least 16 h in an appropriate atmosphere in accordance WIth ISO 2231 .

6
6.1

Procedure
Test method

With the vesse l connected 10 Ihe waler Inlet pipe. open the inlet valve and allow the water to run into Ihe vessel until ,t overflows Check that the top of Ihe vessel IS horizontal by ensuring that Ihe water is uniform ly flush with all I nd I edges . Ensure thai the Inlel pIpe IS totally purged of air, and also that the level of w I rn th lhe zero on the manomete r tube ae , e vesse correspo 5 0 or pressure gauge (see 4.2). Place Ihe lest specimen on the vessel with the face 1 0 be teste d (rnoistened pnor to the test) o n contact wilh the water witho t I " . . u rapping any air under the test specimen.

2

IS 1016 (Part 7) : 2009 ISO 1420: 2001
Fit the retain ing mesh (see 41 ) Secure the test spec imen and the mesh f,rmly on the vessel uSing the clamp, tak ing care to ensure that the edges of the clamp are completely paral let with those of the vessel

6.2

Application of pressure

Open the inlet varve so that the pressure in the vessel gradually Increases at the requrred rate (pressures less than or equal to 30 kPa shall be attained in 1 min ~_ 10 s: pressures of mo re than 30 kPa shall be attained In 2 min � 20 s). Venfy the pressure. Once the required pressure has been reached , adjust the inlet valve. if necessary. and ma intain the pressure for the requ ired time (pressures less than or equa l to 30 kPa shall be maintained for 2 m in: pressures of more than 30 kPa snail be maintained for 5 min) . The test duration WIll therefore be 3 min in the former case and 7 min in the latter. Then Inspect the visible part of the test specimen In order to detect whether any water droplets have passed through the coated tabnc . Close the water inlet valve and return the pressure to zero by opening the evacuation valve . If a leak IS detected in the test specimen clamping zone during the test, begin again .

7

Expression of results

The visible face of the coated fabric shall not have any "water penetration points", nor any trace of moisture. on any of the five test specimens. A "water penetration point" is considered to be any spot in whICh a drop appears as a pin prick. Penetration occurring exactly on the edges of the clamp shall not be considered to be a �water penetrahon point".

8

Test report

The test report shall include the following : a) b) c) d) e) f) g) h) a reference to this International Standard; a description of the coated fabric tested; the conditioning and test atmosphere used; the number of test specimens tested; whether the test specimens were square or circular; which side(s) of the coated fabric were subjected to water pressure; the pressure and the time the pressure was applied; whether the coated fabric passed or failed the test; details of any deviations from the standard test procedure;

i)
j)

the date of the test.
